headline: Fed's Musalem Signals Multiple Rate Hikes May Be Needed Before Spring to Curb Inflation
summary: St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem stated that the US central bank will likely need to implement several interest rate increases before spring 2027 to bring inflation under control.
why: Federal Reserve monetary policy decisions directly shape global borrowing costs, currency valuations, and capital allocation across financial markets.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Federal Reserve official advocated further monetary tightening to curb persistent price pressures.
